desc: Control passed: the uninstrumented maxcpus=2 build produced two kernel traces in four reproducer runs, while the pre-copy validation build produced none. The validation work suppresses the fault but does not identify its cause.
author: claude

result.method_rule: Start each candidate from a fresh boot and run the reproducer at least four times; one clean run is weak evidence.

limitations: The fault occurred only during the first uninstrumented run, showing a first-touch or settling bias.
No uniquely named live console transcript was retained.
